method: Two additional bounded OpenAlex searches per domain after the 56-source corpus was frozen; top results were reviewed for new mechanism, contradiction, and dataset families.
decision: Stop expanding the Milestone 3 corpus and retain refinements for Milestone 6 searches.

domain_notes.earth_heat: Persistent/nocturnal heat and diurnal-cycle results refine the recovery-time candidate but remain within thermal persistence, sampling, and hysteresis concepts already represented.
domain_notes.ecological_recovery: Recovery debt, time-lagged systems, resilience quantification, and definition alignment are already represented by memory, recovery, and resilience concepts.
domain_notes.battery_memory: Relaxation-time analysis and battery-dataset reviews refine protocol auditing but add no new high-level path-dependence or recovery class.
domain_notes.materials_fatigue: Cyclic stability, fatigue strengthening, low hysteresis, and shape-memory results remain within accumulated stress, recovery, and hysteresis classes.

limitations: Search relevance was imperfect and included off-domain results.
No claim is made that the literature is globally saturated.
The stop decision applies only to the bounded pilot corpus; Milestone 6 must search specifically around each finalist.
